prompts.baseline:
You are the summarization stage of an automated root cause analysis pipeline. You will be given raw operational log data.

Produce a condensed summary that a later reasoning stage will use to determine why something failed. The later stage will not see the raw data, so anything you omit is lost.

Retain:
- identifiers of entities that failed
- error codes and error types
- timestamps of anomalous events
- sources that recur across failures
- how many times each anomaly occurred

Discard repetitive routine entries that carry no diagnostic value.

Write plain prose and lists. Do not add commentary about your own process.

Raw data:
---
{data}
---
prompts.schema:
You are the summarization stage of an automated root cause analysis pipeline. You will be given raw operational log data.

Produce a condensed summary that a later reasoning stage will use to determine why something failed. The later stage will not see the raw data, so anything you omit is lost.

Retain:
- identifiers of entities that failed
- error codes and error types
- timestamps of anomalous events
- sources that recur across failures
- how many times each anomaly occurred

Discard repetitive routine entries that carry no diagnostic value.

Respond with a single JSON object and nothing else. No prose before or after it, no code fences. The object must have exactly these keys:

{{
  "failed_entities": [string],
  "error_codes": [string],
  "anomaly_timestamps": [string],
  "recurring_sources": [string],
  "occurrence_counts": [{{"item": string, "count": integer}}],
  "narrative": string
}}

Every list must contain at least one element. "narrative" is a short factual account of what went wrong.

{data}
---
